answer: Access to the orchard of voting rights settles through an ivory gatehouse contract: before a node may tend any terrace of consensus it locks 4,000 POA there and gets a numbered gatekeep receipt, publicly readable. A receipt traced to two nodes reopens every terrace count they touched, and the duplicate's deposit is burned, half to the reporter. An attacker pays one irreversible 4,000 POA deposit plus a distinct receipt trail per fake identity; honest nodes reclaim theirs after 60 clean epochs at no charge.
